Feedback (RLHF), Policy-Interpolated Learning for Aligned Feedback (PILAF) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose Policy-Interpolated Learning for Aligned Feedback (PILAF), a novel response sampling strategy for preference labeling that explicitly aligns preference learning...。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **15× faster**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（See this link  for more information）。
